question:
Select the option to fill in the blank with the most appropriate collocation.

In boarding schools, students need to ______ by themselves.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase **"make the bed"** means **to arrange the bedclothes neatly on the bed.** (बिस्तर ठीक करना)

 
 
• **Example: **Every morning, she makes the bed before leaving for work.
 
 
 
• **"Make" **refers to the act of forming something by putting parts together or combining substances. (बनाना)
 
 
• **Example: **He makes a delicious cake every Sunday.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 2.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Wash the bed** (बिस्तर धोना): This phrase is incorrect because we do not wash the entire bed, only the bed linens or sheets.

 
 
• **Example:** She** washed the bed sheets** every week.
 
 
 
• **Run the bed** (बिस्तर चलाना): This phrase does not make sense in English and is not used.
 
 
• **Example:** There is no correct usage for this phrase.
 
 
 
• **Turn the bed** (बिस्तर घुमाना): This phrase is not appropriate in the context of making a bed.
 
 
• **Example:** The phrase is not commonly used.
